author: Glass Reflection
description:
I put "Chainsmoker Cat" in the A-tier of my seasonal list for the wrong reasons. When I originally ranked this based purely on the absurdity of its gross-out comedy, I wasn't paying close enough attention to the subtle details. Looking past the literal garbage, this series is proving to be a masterclass in honest character writing, social commentary, and emotional depth. 

This might end up being one of the most brilliant tragicomedies of the season... If you can stomach the rainbow vomit long enough to see it.
